rationale: TF-0497 memory-authority validation depends on the DCS catalog memory flags. The catalog default-honesty helper still hard-codes the pre-TF0494 working-memory/tool-registry false lock, so the memory contract cannot be accepted without correcting that stale guard. This proposal records the one exact shared path and the correction; it changes no product defaults, node status, or later node.

execution_hints: authorityDeltaReason=the memory-authority contract validates the DCS memory flag cohort; the catalog default-honesty helper must reflect the TF-0494 baseline-on graduation rather than the pre-graduation mustStayOff list

deviation.summary: The shared DCS default-honesty helper still asserted working-memory and tool-registry must be false after TF-0494 graduated those flags to baseline-on.
deviation.reason: The helper predated TF-0494 and was not updated in that change set; it is consumed by both catalog tests and the coding packaging script.
deviation.correction: Add shared/dcs/prod-flags-catalog.ts to TF-0497 authority and update the helper to assert the two graduated flags are true while keeping the remaining opt-in cohort false. No product default is changed.
